profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Silicon Valley (Santa Clara/San Jose area) data center campus, one of the company's largest US clusters. Two facilities in this group carry independent historic significance: 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco are separate, well known carrier hotel buildings; 365 Main Street was the site of a widely covered July 2007 power outage that took down major web services including Craigslist and other sites hosted there, later becoming a Digital Realty/Digital Realty-heritage asset. SJC10 is documented at 1100 Space Park Drive per Digital Realty's own site.

reading.body:
Digital Realty's Silicon Valley SJC31 facility spans 146,000 square feet with N+1 cooling redundancy, but the operator has not published its power capacity, making it impossible to assess its contribution to regional compute infrastructure from public sources.

The facility is part of Digital Realty's largest US data center cluster, concentrated in the Santa Clara and San Jose area. This geographic concentration reflects the historical pull of Silicon Valley as a technology hub, though it also creates a single point of failure risk for major internet services. The July 2007 outage at the company's 365 Main Street facility, which disrupted Craigslist and other major services, demonstrated how dependent web-scale operations are on specific buildings in specific regions.

The absence of published power figures for SJC31 illustrates a broader pattern in the data center industry. Operators often withhold capacity details on their own websites, even as the power constraint on AI scaling becomes increasingly central to infrastructure planning. Without this data, researchers and planners cannot determine whether Silicon Valley's existing building stock can support growing compute demand, or whether the region's power grid is already the binding constraint on local AI expansion. The facility's redundancy specification suggests operational maturity, but redundancy in cooling does not specify total power draw or available headroom.
